title: PerspectiveCoach: Exploring LLMs for Developer Reflection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the fidelity of developers' perspective-taking and restatements of a user's experience with online gender-based harassment using text similarity metrics (TF-IDF, chrF++, ROUGE-L, SBERT) and qualitative coding.

Measuring developers' ability to accurately reflect on and restate the ethical concerns of Muslim women facing targeted harassment during Eid, using text similarity metrics to assess perspective-taking.
Examining human-human perspective-taking through restatement tasks involving user concerns such as geographic discrimination and restricted access to digital services based on location.
